quizzes.title: T.R. in the Badlands
quizzes.blurb: In 1883 a bespectacled New York assemblyman got off a train in Dakota Territory to hunt buffalo. He left three years later a cattleman. Fifteen questions on the country that made him.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt in buckskin, photographed in 1885
